name: Tomb of Akhenaten

features.name: Sticky Win Spins
features.description: Respins that grow up to 3,125 ways.

features.name: Pyramid Wilds
features.description: A chance at a wild section on the last level.

review:
An Egyptian game where any win triggers Sticky Win Spins – up to three respins that expand the ways all the way to 3,125. On the final level, Pyramid Wilds can turn a section of the grid wild.

Three or more bonus symbols start Akhenaten Spins. It's rated medium volatility, but with a surprisingly big 20,932x max and a 33% hit rate. A nice balance.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
